open_points.subject: advance_run mapped value-list ceiling handling
open_points.text: every delivered list of a mapped node MUST be measured before any of them is delivered or written, and when one exceeds the ceiling none of them is delivered, to a node or a flow output;
open_points.other_text: a mapped node whose delivered value list is over the stored value ceiling counting as failed by the same derivation,
open_points.question: Must an over-ceiling mapped value list be treated as delivered, or must it never be delivered?

open_points.subject: advance_run empty mapped value outputs
open_points.text: A value port's PortRef names exactly one StoredValue; a mapped node's value output, once every element succeeded, is one StoredValue holding the canonical JSON array of the elements' values in element order, whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's value_schema as items, of the highest class among the elements, an empty list taking the highest class among the node's inputs, the mapped list and every other input, published with put_value_bytes and written by runs when the list is first delivered, never in an element's own change;
open_points.other_text: A mapped node over an empty list executes and sends nothing and writes one NodeExecution succeeded without map_index, executed naming its pinned implementation or binding, every output an empty list;
open_points.question: For an empty mapped node whose value output is never delivered, must its empty-list StoredValue be written for the NodeExecution output, or must it remain unwritten until delivery?
